verdict.rationale: Relay docs explicitly confirm issuing physical debit/credit Visa cards to team members with defined roles and spend limits (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-16, relay-docs-26, relay-docs-31), plus card management features like freezing/replacing cards (relay-docs-8) and role-based access. Community evidence corroborates card limits and general permission functionality, with minor mentions of permission glitches. Missing for 10: deeper independent hands-on verification of the role-definition granularity and any documented failures specific to physical card issuance.
